validity.label: Passes PyroSync's validation rules for this configuration

checks.label: Model fitted
checks.rule: At least 30 training and 10 held-out units, and a non-constant VIIRS value.

checks.label: Measurement eligible for application
checks.rule: Only detection counts may be applied. FRP sums are evaluated but never applied: on the full Indonesia archive the log-log model did not reduce held-out FRP errors (docs/HARMONIZATION_VALIDATION.md, run E).

checks.label: Enough held-out units
checks.rule: At least 100 held-out units.

checks.label: Better than unadjusted VIIRS
checks.rule: Held-out MAE, RMSE and |MBE| all lower than using the raw VIIRS value (M̂ = V).

checks.label: Better than a constant model
checks.value: MAE 0.842 vs best constant 0.894; RMSE 1.423 vs best constant 1.595
checks.rule: Held-out MAE and RMSE both lower than the better of two constants fitted on the training period (MODIS mean, MODIS median), i.e. the VIIRS value adds information beyond the overall level.

checks.label: VIIRS slope clearly positive
checks.rule: Lower bound of the 95 % interval of β above 0 (intervals are optimistic because units are correlated).

validity.scope: Valid only for the AOI, dates, filters, sensor pair, grid, tolerance and unit set of this run. Calibrated values before the held-out period are in-sample. Satellite coverage is not verified, and MODIS is a reference scale, not ground truth.
validity.applies_to: Map estimates and time series in the Harmonization tab. The calendar, history, Explore map and Sensor Workbench always show original observations.

improvement_vs_unadjusted.definition: 100 × (unadjusted − calibrated) / unadjusted. Positive = calibrated error is smaller. For MBE the absolute bias is compared.
100 × (unadjusted − calibrated) / unadjusted. Positive = calibrated error is smaller. For MBE the absolute bias is compared.

check.definition: Daily totals over the AOI on days where both sensors have a known coverage state. Unlike the unit-level evaluation, these totals include VIIRS-only and MODIS-only events, so they show whether the estimate reproduces MODIS-scale activity levels, not only matched pairs.

checks.label: Unit-level validation passed
checks.rule: The run passes the unit-level validity rules (see validation status).

checks.label: Enough held-out days
checks.rule: At least 30 held-out days on which both sensors have a known coverage state.

checks.label: Total level close to MODIS
checks.rule: Over the held-out days the summed estimate is between 0.8× and 1.25× the summed MODIS detections.

checks.label: Daily totals better than unadjusted VIIRS
checks.rule: Held-out daily-total MAE and RMSE below the raw VIIRS totals.

checks.label: Daily totals better than a constant
checks.rule: Held-out daily-total MAE and RMSE below a constant equal to the training-period mean daily MODIS total.

totals_validity.label: Calibrated totals are not validated for this configuration: the calibrated line is not drawn
totals_validity.note: Unit-level results describe matched comparison units; a time series sums estimates over all events in the AOI, including events the model was not fitted on, so it needs its own check.
